title: DSP Advertising | Demand Side Platform | Yahoo Inc.

facts.fact: Yahoo DSP states that Yahoo Backstage inventory is certified MFA-free by Jounce Media.
facts.quote: Exclusive access to premium ad inventory with a direct path to top-tier supply — and certified MFA-free by Jounce Media.

facts.fact: Yahoo DSP's Open APIs cover trafficking, reporting, conversion, and bring-your-own-algorithm functions under one authentication.
facts.quote: Trafficking, Reporting, Conversion, and Bring Your Own Algorithm, all under one auth.

facts.fact: Yahoo DSP's MCP servers can be connected to AI assistants such as Claude or Cursor, or wired into a user's own agents and workflows.
facts.quote: Ask questions from an AI assistant like Claude or Cursor, or wire our MCP servers into your own agents and workflows.

facts.fact: Yahoo DSP's Backstage partner logos shown on the page include Warner Brothers Discovery, Fox, Paramount, A&E, AMC, DirecTV, VIZIO, and LG.
facts.quote: From marketing intelligence to tech solutions, our supply network provides what you need to take your campaign performance to the next level.
